answer: Each epoch every timber sells its fixed quota of admission slots by sealed bid, and a yarrow may sign only one live bid — no clone bids twice through one hardware key. Winning bids are paid in ember and burned. An operator's k-th clone bids against the k−1 slots its own clones already hold: every price it raises, its later clones must beat too, so the k-th clone clears near k×base ember while one honest newcomer still bids base. The burn never merges, transfers or refunds.
